# Minerals Solutions

> Heavy industrial process machinery manufacturer specializing in high-efficiency rotary drum dryers, sand washing plants, fertilizer granulation lines, and material handling conveyor systems engineered in Gujarat, India.

## Industrial Rotary Dryers & Thermal Systems

- [Industrial Rotary Dryers Hub](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/): Comprehensive overview of single-pass direct heat, concentric double-pass return drum, and triple-pass high-efficiency dryers (500 kg/hr to 50 TPH capacity).
- [Triple Pass Rotary Drum Dryer](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/triple-pass-dryer/): MS-TPD series, 3 to 30 TPH capacity with 30% to 40% thermal fuel savings and compact physical footprint.
- [Industrial Rotary Sand Dryer](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/sand-dryer/): MS-RSD series, 5 to 45 TPH capacity for silica sand, foundry sand, and river sand with discharge moisture below 0.5%.
- [Stainless Chemical Powder Dryer](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/chemical-powder-dryer/): MS-CPD series with SS 304 / SS 316 contact parts, mirror finish, and zero cross-contamination for chemical and food powders.
- [Biomass & Sawdust Rotary Dryer](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/biomass-sawdust-dryer/): MS-BSD series, 1 to 12 TPH capacity with spark arrestors and explosion relief vents for wood chips, sawdust, and bagasse.

## Sand Washing Plants & Hydrocyclone Separators

- [Sand Washing Plants Hub](https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/): Industrial bucket wheel sand washers, high-pressure hydrocyclone desliming circuits, spiral classifiers, and dewatering screens (30 to 200 TPH).
- [Silica Sand Washing Plant](https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/silica-sand-washing-plant/): MS-SWP series, 30 to 200 TPH capacity reducing clay, silt, and mica content below 0.5% for glass and foundry grades.
- [Bucket Wheel Sand Washing Machine](https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/bucket-wheel-sand-washer/): MS-BWW series, 40 to 180 TPH throughput with wear-resistant polyurethane screen panels and low motor power demand.
- [Hydrocyclone Fine Sand Recovery Unit](https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/hydrocyclone-sand-separator/): MS-FSR series, 60 to 120 m³/hr slurry throughput recovering 95%+ of 75-150 micron (100-200 mesh) valuable fine sand.
- [Heavy Mineral Log Washer](https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/mineral-log-washer/): MS-LW series, 30 to 150 TPH capacity with twin-shaft high-chrome alloy paddles for scouring tough plastic clay.

## Fertilizer Granulation & Pellet Plants

- [Fertilizer Granulation Plants Hub](https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/): Turnkey bio-organic fertilizer, vermicompost, NPK compound, and DAP granulation production lines (1 to 20 TPH).
- [Industrial Pan Disc Fertilizer Granulator](https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/disc-granulator/): MS-PG series, 1 to 8 TPH throughput with stepless tilt angle (40° to 55°) and 93%+ spherical 2.0-4.5mm granule yield.
- [Double Roller Compaction Granulator](https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/double-roller-granulator/): MS-DRG series, 1 to 5 TPH throughput operating at ambient temperature with zero moisture addition and zero drying fuel.
- [Industrial Rotary Drum Granulator](https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/rotary-drum-granulator/): MS-RDG series, 3 to 20 TPH continuous tumbling agglomeration with non-stick UHMWPE anti-corrosion inner lining.
- [Fertilizer Cooling & Coating Drum](https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/fertilizer-cooling-coating-drum/): MS-CCD series, dual-stage counter-current rotary cooler and micronized anti-caking agent coating drum.

## Industrial Conveyors & Heavy Mechanical Spares

- [Industrial Conveyors & Spares Hub](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/): Bulk material handling conveyors, bucket elevators, screw feeders, and forged spare parts.
- [Heavy Duty Industrial Bucket Elevators](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/bucket-elevators/): MS-BEL centrifugal and continuous discharge vertical bucket elevator systems up to 45m vertical discharge height.
- [Industrial U-Trough & Tubular Screw Conveyors](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/screw-conveyors/): MS-SC series, 3 to 50 TPH dust-tight enclosed powder and bulk material transfer conveyors.
- [Forged Steel Rotary Dryer Support Rollers & Tyres](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/forged-trunnion-rollers/): MS-TR series forged 42CrMo4 and EN-9 trunnion rollers induction-hardened to 280-320 BHN with SKF/FAG bearings.
- [Industrial Troughed Belt Conveyor Systems](https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/belt-conveyors/): MS-BC series, 20 to 500 TPH heavy-duty CEMA-C/D idler belt conveyors compliant with IS 11592 standards.
